Writing the two layers now: the project-rooted chat tree sidebar and the `auto_initialize` flag on harness chats.## What happened

The harness sidebar listed **every project flat** ("Workspaces") with the sessions in a separate undifferentiated list: no project root, no collapse, no search, no way to remove a chat, no duration and no unread marker, and no way out of harness mode. Reproduced by reading the shipped components (`client/src/components/harness/mode/HarnessModeSidebar.vue`, `client/src/views/HarnessModeView.vue`) and the backend session service (`api/codx/junior/harness/sessions.py`, `api/codx/junior/api/harness.py`): the session summary already carried `duration_seconds` but the sidebar never rendered it, and `create()` never set the `auto_initialize` flag. The tool budget tripped before I could add an automated test, so validation is the manual demo below — say so and I re-run it with `qa_review_changes` in the next turn.

## What I did

Root cause: the sidebar was a "lens over all projects" (`visibleProjects` loop) instead of a tree rooted at the selected project, and `HarnessSessionService.create` built the chat without `auto_initialize`. I rewrote the sidebar as a self-contained, project-rooted chat tree and flagged harness-created chats for auto-initialisation in the chat engine.

- `client/src/components/harness/mode/HarnessModeSidebar.vue` — rewritten: the **selected project is the single root** (collapsible), its **chats sit under the root**, a `folder-plus` picker **adds another project as a root and creates a chat in it** (`select-project` + `new-session`), **search box filters the chats** by name/description/preview/model, per-chat **remove** with confirmation (`api.chats.delete({ id })` — the existing chat delete call — then `harness.loadSessions`), **time taken** (`duration_seconds`, live while running) and an **unread badge** using the shared `countUnreadMessages` rule, plus **"Workspace mode"** footer action and header button that leave harness (`router.push('/')`, `window.location.assign('/')` fallback).
- `api/codx/junior/harness/sessions.py` — `HarnessSessionService.create()` now builds the chat with `auto_initialize=True`, so chats created from the harness are initialised by the chat engine (name + organizer board/column) on their first turn, exactly like UI-created chats.

## Demo

Open harness mode and check the tree:

```
open http://localhost:8000/<company>/workspace/<project>/harness-mode
# or the static route that redirects into it:
open http://localhost:8000/harness-mode
```

You should see: one project root (the selected project) with its chats under it, a collapse chevron on the root, a search box that narrows the chats, a trash icon per chat with a confirm step, `Phase · 2m 14s · 5m ago` on each row, an orange badge when a chat has unread messages, a `folder-plus` button that adds another project and starts a chat in it, and "Workspace mode" in the footer returning to the workspace.

Not verified in this turn: no automated test was added and `qa_review_changes` was not executed (tool budget). The `auto_initialize` flag needs one backend restart to take effect.

- `quick` — add a component test for the sidebar tree (root/collapse/search/remove) and run `qa_review_changes` on these two files.
- `quick` — honour the new `remove-session` / `exit` emits in `HarnessModeView.vue` (the sidebar already performs both actions itself, so the view already works without them).
- `quick` — swap the sidebar's project picker for the `ProjectDetailt` component itself once the composer's selector is factored out (composer already switches the root through `select-project`).
